node.title: Re: Why can't I open a file for writing?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Something I noticed in addition to the comments about open ... or die:

my $dir = '/some/directory/here'; my @files = <$dir/\d{6}*>; # All the relevant files start with 6 numbers, so don't glob others!

Sorry but I don't see how the pattern <$dir/\d{6}*> can be working at all* - [doc://glob] does not recognize regex syntax, unless you're using some custom module. Always [id://111088] - you should be seeing a warning like "Unrecognized escape \d passed through".

Also, be very careful with what $dir contains, and in fact with [doc://glob] in general, as discussed in the recent thread [id://1206848].

* Update: Or rather, how it is working in the context provided, "All the relevant files start with 6 numbers" - thanks for pointing this out, [Lotus1]!
